name: Kazama Akira
source:
Kazama Akira recently came back to Tokiwa village with his mother. On his trip to the village shrine he was reunited with [spoiler]his old childhood friend, [url=https://vndb.org/c3130]Minase Itsuki[/url]. Their reunion brought back all kinds of memories from the times when they were still playing with each other and generally had a good time together[/spoiler]. As their past and present interweaves, what will the fate bring to them ... ?

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=43]MangaGamer[/url]]
